sources.title: Piracy monthly report February 2025
sources.text: Duty crew onboard a bulk carrier underway noticed three unauthorized individuals at the aft stations. Alarm raised and crew mustered. Seeing the crew alertness, the individuals escaped empty handed. The incident reported to VTIS. Upon anchoring, the vessel was boarded by the coast guard for investigations.
